p_documentation: Edit the language JSON and templates in `.readme/` and `.changelog/`, then regenerate the documents. Do not edit generated Markdown directly. The root README uses Simplified Chinese. These commands require Python 3.10 or newer without extra Python packages; Windows can use `py` instead of `python`. `--check` validates languages, fields, historical versions and dates, punctuation, and generated files without writing. CI runs the same check.
p_app_intro: AutoJs4 is a JavaScript automation tool for Android with accessibility service support. This repository is based on the final open-source Auto.js release `4.1.1 Alpha2` (build `461`), preserving its source and applying the updates needed to build and run it on recent Android versions.
p_app_history: Auto.js was first released by [hyb1996](https://github.com/hyb1996) on `2017/01/27`, and maintenance ended on `2020/03/13`. AutoJs4 began development from that release on `2023/04/11` and remains free and open source.
p_baseline: [AutoJs4]({{ app_url }}) is the behavioral baseline of [AutoJs6](http://project.autojs6.com): apart from a few specific cases, scripts that run correctly on AutoJs4 should produce exactly the same effects and results on AutoJs6.
p_docs_relation: [AutoJs4-Documentation]({{ docs_url }}) preserves the applicable open-source Auto.js `4.1.0` documentation and serves as the reference baseline of [AutoJs6-Documentation](http://docs-project.autojs6.com). The application version `4.1.1 Alpha2` and documentation version `4.1.0` are distinct labels.
p_runtime: [AutoJs6-Plugin-AutoJs4-Runtime]({{ runtime_url }}) embeds the AutoJs4 engine modules `autojs`, `common`, and `automator` through a Git submodule and runs scripts in a separate process. "Run with AutoJs4" in the AutoJs6 file manager enables result comparisons without installing AutoJs4 separately.
p_environment: Android 4.4 (API 19, KITKAT) or later. See [project-versions.json]({{ app_url }}/blob/master/project-versions.json) for the current application version and build parameters.
p_reading: [Read AutoJs4 documentation online]({{ docs_site_url }}) / [Markdown documentation sources]({{ docs_url }}/tree/main/api) / [Preserved HTML documentation]({{ docs_url }}/tree/main/docs).
p_app_links: [Download AutoJs4]({{ app_url }}/releases) / [Report an issue]({{ app_url }}/issues) / [In-app Simplified Chinese release history]({{ app_url }}/blob/master/app/src/main/assets/doc/CHANGELOG.md).
p_other_projects: [AutoJs6](http://project.autojs6.com) continues development from Auto.js. [AutoJs6-Documentation](http://docs-project.autojs6.com) supplies the shared content source for its [online documentation](https://docs.autojs6.com) and offline documentation plugin.
p_archive: The [original Auto.js 4.1.1 Alpha2 repository introduction]({{ original_readme_url }}) is preserved byte for byte from the original commit, without translation. The [original source and document entry]({{ original_tree_url }}) is pinned to the same historical commit. Old links inside the original remain unchanged; the API documentation also has an [Auto.js 4.1.0 historical snapshot]({{ historical_docs_url }}).

p_features:
- JavaScript IDE with code completion, variable renaming, and code formatting.
- Accessibility automation and selector APIs to find and traverse controls, inspect information, and perform actions, similar to UiAutomator.
- Floating controls for recording and running scripts, viewing package and activity names, and inspecting layout hierarchies and control bounds.
- Script recording and playback, screen capture and saving, image color search, and image matching.
- E4X interfaces and packaging scripts or projects as APK files.
- Root-enabled extensions for taps, swipes, recording, and Shell commands.
- Tasker plugin support and desktop development through VSCode with [AutoJs4-VSCode-Extension](https://github.com/SuperMonster003/AutoJs4-VSCode-Extension).
text_readme_dependency: Adjusted versions of some dependencies or local libraries
